title: Lior and the Orbit
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: Sable Hartwell, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
